metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins for building a data engineering platform (data engineering, backend/distributed architecture, frontend, TDD, CI/CD, governance). Derived from wshobson/agents (MIT).

plugins.name: apache-iceberg
plugins.description: Apache Iceberg lakehouse skills, agents and runnable Spark/PyIceberg/Trino samples: table format and metadata, catalogs (REST, Polaris, Nessie), ingestion and CDC, federation and consumption, maintenance and metadata tables, operations (orchestration, WAP, disaster recovery), Python engines and lakehouse planning

plugins.name: apache-polaris
plugins.description: Apache Polaris (Iceberg REST catalog) skills, agents and runnable Docker labs: catalog fundamentals and credential vending, access control (principals, principal roles, catalog roles, privileges), management and catalog REST APIs, federation with external catalogs and migration, OSS deployment, configuration and the polaris CLI, and engine integrations with Spark, Snowflake and Dremio

plugins.name: apache-superset
plugins.description: Apache Superset (6.x) on the data platform: Kubernetes deployment (Stackable/Helm), Keycloak OIDC + role mapping, RLS and multi-tenant embedding with guest tokens, dashboards-as-code (superset-cli sync, GitOps), dataset/semantic-layer design over Trino/ClickHouse/Iceberg, caching/async performance, dashboard design and lifecycle (Few, Knaflic, Tufte, Wexler, Kirk, Desbarats), chart selection and verified chart-API limits, colour accessibility, privacy compliance, AI layer (governed MCP, NL2SQL), Superset internals, Extensions and MCP

plugins.name: api-scaffolding
plugins.description: REST and GraphQL API scaffolding, framework selection, backend architecture, and API generation

plugins.name: backend-development
plugins.description: Backend API design, GraphQL architecture, workflow orchestration with Temporal, and test-driven backend development

plugins.name: c4-architecture
plugins.description: Comprehensive C4 architecture documentation workflow with bottom-up code analysis, component synthesis, container mapping, and context diagram generation

plugins.name: cicd-automation
plugins.description: CI/CD pipeline configuration, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI workflow setup, and automated deployment pipeline orchestration

plugins.name: code-documentation
plugins.description: Documentation generation, code explanation, and technical writing with automated doc generation and tutorial creation

plugins.name: code-refactoring
plugins.description: Code cleanup, refactoring automation, and technical debt management with context restoration

plugins.name: coding-standards
plugins.description: Coding standards for a data platform codebase: Python, SQL/dbt, PySpark, YAML/Kubernetes/Airflow config, TypeScript, error handling and logging, documentation, Git workflow; with reviewer and style-guide-author agents, lint/pre-commit setup and standards-review commands

plugins.name: comprehensive-review
plugins.description: Multi-perspective code analysis covering architecture, security, and best practices

plugins.name: database-design
plugins.description: Database architecture, schema design, and SQL optimization for production systems

plugins.name: database-migrations
plugins.description: Database migration automation, observability, and cross-database migration strategies

plugins.name: data-engineering
plugins.description: ETL pipeline construction, data warehouse design, batch processing workflows, and data-driven feature development

plugins.name: data-engineering-design-patterns
plugins.description: Data pipeline design patterns as skills, agents and Spark/Kafka/Airflow code samples: ingestion, error management, idempotency, data value, flow, security, storage, quality, observability, integration

plugins.name: data-governance
plugins.description: Product-neutral data governance for a data platform, built from an evidence-based study of governance tools (OpenMetadata 1.13.3, DataHub 1.7.0, Apache Atlas 2.5.0 as measured examples): data contracts and data products; catalog selection, lineage and impact analysis; classification, access control and masking; quality SLAs and incidents; KVKK (Turkish data protection law 6698) obligations mapped to platform controls; anonymisation (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, re-identification risk, ARX limits, documents); and a 14-domain / 90-capability assessment rubric with evidence discipline

plugins.name: deployment-strategies
plugins.description: Deployment patterns, rollback automation, and infrastructure templates

plugins.name: developer-essentials
plugins.description: Essential developer skills including Git workflows, SQL optimization, error handling, code review, E2E testing, authentication, debugging, and monorepo management

plugins.name: distributed-debugging
plugins.description: Distributed system tracing and debugging across microservices

plugins.name: frontend-mobile-development
plugins.description: Frontend UI development and mobile application implementation across platforms

plugins.name: full-stack-orchestration
plugins.description: End-to-end feature orchestration with testing, security, performance, and deployment

plugins.name: git-pr-workflows
plugins.description: Git workflow automation, pull request enhancement, and team onboarding processes

plugins.name: kubernetes-operations
plugins.description: Kubernetes manifest generation, networking configuration, security policies, observability setup, GitOps workflows, and auto-scaling

plugins.name: naming-conventions
plugins.description: Research-backed naming conventions for code identifiers, data assets (layers, tables, columns, dbt models), Kafka topics, pipelines/DAGs, Kubernetes and Azure resources, APIs and a controlled glossary; with audit, scheme-design and rename-planning commands

plugins.name: observability-monitoring
plugins.description: Metrics collection, logging infrastructure, distributed tracing, SLO implementation, and monitoring dashboards

plugins.name: openmetadata
plugins.description: OpenMetadata (1.13.x) as the governance catalog of an on-prem data platform, built from a code-level capability study of 1.13.3 (commit 255f6694): architecture, entity model (JSON Schema), extension points and deployment footprint; connector and lineage coverage for Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, MinIO, ClickHouse, Trino, dbt, Spark, Airflow, NiFi, Great Expectations, Ranger and Vault; a prioritised gap catalog with implementation routes on OpenMetadata's real structures; KVKK (Turkish data protection law 6698) compliance mapping and gaps; a 14-domain / 90-capability governance assessment rubric with evidence discipline and DataHub/Atlas comparison; and new LLM, agentic and ontology capability candidates with novelty checks and a design template

plugins.name: platform-engineering
plugins.description: Build a data platform as a reusable, productizable product: platform-as-product thinking, config-driven design, microkernel/plugin architecture, multi-tenancy, versioned APIs/SDKs and automated architectural governance (fitness functions)

plugins.name: project-nessie
plugins.description: Project Nessie (0.108.x, 2026) as the HKM platform's Iceberg catalog: Git-like branches/tags/commits, Nessie Catalog with Iceberg REST endpoint and S3 signing / credential vending on Dell ObjectScale, Ceph RGW or MinIO AIStor, production deployment (Helm, JDBC/PostgreSQL version store, OIDC via Keycloak), CEL metadata authorization alongside Apache Ranger, engine integrations (Trino, Spark, Flink, ClickHouse, dbt), branch-based workflows (per-institution branches, write-audit-publish, release tags), garbage collection and KVKK erasure, CLI/REST API and migration from Apache Polaris

plugins.name: python-development
plugins.description: Modern Python development with Python 3.12+, Django, FastAPI, async patterns, and production best practices

plugins.name: qa-test-strategy
plugins.description: QA process and test strategy for the data platform: software testing lifecycle, test case lifecycle, test plan/strategy documents, test suite taxonomy, requirement traceability and coverage, defect management (priority x severity), non-functional and performance testing, QA metrics and test reports, and a platform-specific test inventory generator (data, pipelines, engines, infra, security, BI)

plugins.name: review-agent-governance
plugins.description: Require a human approval signal before an AI agent can post PR reviews, comments, merges, or writes to CI config. Cedar-gated, receipt-signed, designed for the Hermes-style failure mode where a review bot posts without oversight.

plugins.name: security-compliance
plugins.description: SOC2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliance validation, secrets scanning, compliance checklists, and regulatory documentation

plugins.name: spark-code-optimizer
plugins.description: PySpark code optimizer built on the sparkopt rule engine: joins, aggregations, I/O and partitioning, persistence (cache / localCheckpoint / checkpoint / StorageLevel), physical-plan analysis and complex workloads, with an offline CLI that turns a DataFrame profile or explain() plan into prioritized recommendations and code

plugins.name: spark-property-based-testing
plugins.description: Property-based testing for PySpark with Hypothesis: DataFrame strategies (nulls, skew, edge cases), schema and nested-type contract tests, Great Expectations 1.x content checks, transformation invariants (row counts, sums, idempotency, joins, windows), plus a bundled spark-prop-testing library with pytest plugin, CLI and HTML reports

plugins.name: tdd-workflows
plugins.description: Test-driven development methodology with red-green-refactor cycles and code review

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: Comprehensive UI/UX design plugin for mobile (iOS, Android, React Native) and web applications with design systems, accessibility, and modern patterns

plugins.name: unit-testing
plugins.description: Unit and integration test automation for Python and JavaScript with debugging support
